newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 21.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 21.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones shed 57.40 points to 6,820.28.
* The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange Composite Index of 100 large-capitalisation stocks fell 8.84 points to 1,225.99.
* The all-share EMAS index dropped 2.58 points to 359.17.
* Infrastructure construction conglomerate Renong announced net profit of 230.52 million ringgit for half-year ended December 31, 1996, up from 113.96 million previously.
* United Engineers posted a 90 percent increase in 1996 net profit to 513.21 million ringgit.
* Time Engineering reported a 28 percent drop in 1996 net profit to 26.86 million ringgit.
* Tan Chong Motor posted a 1996 net profit of 257.79 million ringgit, up from 135.17 million in 1995.
* Esso Malaysia reported a 35.4 percent decline in 1996 net profit to 58.13 million ringgit.
